title: New Releases: 4 New RPG Maker Resource Packs Available Now!

posts.author: RPGMakerWeb
posts.body:
Two new Tilesets and two new Music packs available now for RPG Maker!
​
Send your heroes into dungeons with powerful music tracks supporting them thanks to the Labyrinths around the World pack! CarrotWine is here with a pack of 19 BGMs to fill your dungeons with new music, whether your dungeon is a simple starting cave where your heroes learn the basic of combat or your dungeon is a haunted optional one where the ghosts of bosses past ready themselves for round 2!
This pack’s 16 dungeon tracks are named after rocks and minerals to help you find fitting places for each without being forced to stick to certain dungeon tropes. ‘Ghost Quartz Labyrinth’ has a slow piano melody punctuated by echoing wails and spooky screeches of strings, which could be perfect for both exploring a graveyard in the dead of night or sneaking into an evil factory. ‘Coral Labyrinth’s calming wind instruments and strings could fit a cavern area found on a local beach or a forest area where streams criss-cross between towering oaks. Need something to keep the energy up while searching for clues? Then use ‘Amethyst Labyrinth’ with its electronic beat or ‘Malachite Labyrinth’ with its strummed strings and pan pipes. This pack also includes 1 event track for a somber reveal during the story and 2 opening tracks that could double as an upbeat world map track or relaxed village tune! Each track comes in M4a and Ogg file formats, so they’re ready to be added into your MV/MZ project right away.
Purchase Now on
KOMODO Plaza
or on
Steam
!
​
Show off your hero’s green thumb with NATHUHARUCA Green Tilesets! NATHUHARUCA is back with another pack of decorative tiles, this time focusing on turning dreary empty rooms into wonderful greenhouses filled with potted plants. Add a natural focal point with a large tree trunk or arch of greenery to your maps, and keep players from wandering into specific zones with 8-tile wide bushes and brick planters. Give your alchemist some glass vases filled with rare herb clippings, your elven village a cute wooden chair hung with flowers from a tree branch, your traveling florist a wooden cart filled with potted flowers, and more with this pack!
15 different designs cover a variety of situations, from wooden shelves lined with vases bursting with flowers and cute cacti protected in glass cases to Japanese-inspired bamboo and pruned maples carefully placed in rock gardens and leafless trees covered in shiny lights and ornaments ready to bring some cheer to a winter scene! Each image comes in multiple sizes so you can use them in cutscenes or as tiles on maps. Use the largest size when you shrink your heroes down for a silly sidequest, and place the smallest versions of the vases on tables and shelves to decorate a florist’s home. Add in a color variation for each design and angled versions to better fit certain scenes, and this pack hits a whopping 67 B sheets! Add some eye-catching potted plants and decorations to your game with NATHUHARUCA Green Tilesets!
Purchase Now on
KOMODO Plaza
or on
Steam
!
​
Add a fortress ruled by an evil knight organization to your game with the NEONPIXEL - Mega Dark Medieval Age pack! Neonpixel is back with another massive tileset pack to help you build castles in the middle of forests than you’d know what to do with! Create a haunted fort that was abandoned centuries ago, a bustling stone town where knights gather to train, a tower on the edge of the sea, and more with this pack! A1, A2, A4, and B-E sheets are ready for you to build stone and wooden exteriors and interiors, be it comfortable bedrooms with canopy beds and tall arched window or busy training areas where the grass has been crushed into the dirt under heavy feet and barrels and wooden barricades form miniature arenas for soldiers to master their spears and swords. Each sheet comes in a variety of colors and filters, so you’ve got more than 150 files to choose from! Create a castle by the sea with blue-toned stone, and show flashbacks on sepia maps.
This pack also includes a number of character sprites to add more movement to your maps! 11 sheets with fires can warm up any map with a bonfire or light up a hallway with wall-mounted torches, and 6 sheets of cloth banners and 140 waving flags can help your heroes identify friends and foes from a distance. 101 trees with rustling leaves can add life to forest paths and 13 sheets of armed knights can guard every fort, each with their armor’s color matching their home’s distinct palette. If you’ve been waiting for another pack in Neonpixel’s unique style, check out NEONPIXEL - Mega Dark Medieval Age!
Purchase Now on
KOMODO Plaza
or on
Steam
!
​
Give your cutscenes, towns, and battles music tracks that strike the perfect balance between modern synths and nostalgic melodies with Nid Retro RPG BGM vol.1! Nid is here with a pack of BGMs that can help fill your game with a consistent style so your players can go from towns to dungeons to combat without getting auditory whiplash. 21 BGMs cover battles, dungeons, fields, events, towns, and other scenes are all you need to add tunes to a short game! Switch between ‘Battle - Battle 1’ and ‘Battle - Battle 2’ tracks depending on your hero’s health or use them randomly so that each normal battle doesn’t feel exactly the same. Search creepy underground tunnels to ‘Dungeon - Dungeon’s slow and spooky tunes, and enjoy some minigames while the quirky and upbeat ‘Other - Shop’ plays. Slip in the backstory of two party members with a cutscene where the soft sounds of ‘Event - Memories of Two’ play while they recall when they first met, and have ‘Field - Volcanic Zone’s horn echo off mountains while your party climbs towards the peak to defeat a dragon!
Also included are 3 MEs to help with certain scenes. Use ‘ME - Item Get’ whenever your hero opens a chest to give your players a boost of excitement when wondering what they’ll find, and have ‘ME - Mystery’ or the longer ‘ME - The Unknown’ play when doors are unlocked or puzzles are introduced to the players. Each track comes in M4a and Ogg file formats so you can easily add it to your MV/MZ games, or use it in your favorite engine! Pick up Nid Retro RPG BGM vol.1 and fill your project with music that seamlessly blends into your game’s world!
